notes.content: [p]Hi friends![/p][p][/p][p]I'm happy to announce that [i]Camille and Laura[/i] will release on August 12th![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128825/546bc1d017a4e01c07e8ca10c5b2925448248e3d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Developing this game solo has been a whirlwind and I hope you are as excited to play it as I am to share it with you all![/p][p]The game will be available on PC for now. notes.title: Camille and Laura gets the Hidden Gem mention at the DevGAMM awards!
notes.content:
Hi friends!

I'm pretty proud and excited to share with you today that my small game got shared on a big stage! Camille and Laura received the "Hidden Gem" mention during the DevGAMM award ceremony. You can watch the ceremony below and catch my game around the 49 minutes mark!

[previewyoutube=Ygg7Kz2nJr0;full][/previewyoutube]

Seeing my small game on a big stage around massive games like [i]Manor Lords[/i] is an incredible feeling. Working solo on small and niche projects can be very lonely and I often get the false impression that nobody care about what I am doing. Getting a mention like this and all the support I have received from people on Steam and on social media help me tremendously and remind me that my work is appreciated.

I am very thankful for you reading this and for the DevGAMM community. I'm proud of working on this gem and I can't wait for players to get their hands on it.

notes.title: Demo release!
notes.content:
Hi friends!

I wanted to tell you all that the first demo for Camille and Laura was released today!

None of the content is final and I am sure there will be issues here and there. I'm working on the game solo and I cannot account for everything, but it will help you get an idea of what I am going for with the game. I hope you will find something to appreciate in it and I appreciate any feedback you can give me.

Thank you so much for your time.
Olivier
